visualCharacteristics.summary: Three icon tabs switching the panels below; trailing 'Mehr über AMAG Bülach' band with tab-switch links
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Garage page tab bar — three equal icon tiles (grey, active tile white with a coloured 5px top border: violet / dark blue / light blue) above a 1px viewport-wide line. The panels are the following page sections tagged with section metadata `Tab`; only the active tab's sections show. An optional trailing row renders the grey "Mehr über …" anchor band after the last panel, linking to the other tabs
visualCharacteristics.differsFromBase: No local tabs block; Block Collection tabs used as template source only. Icon tab tiles, section-metadata-grouped panels and trailing 'Mehr über' band row.
visualCharacteristics.layout: tiles stacked icon-over-label below 1200px, icon beside label at >= 1200px; band: headline + links in a row at >= 1200px
visualCharacteristics.interaction: click / Enter / Space / arrow keys switch tabs; band links and #<tab-id> URL hashes switch tabs and scroll to the bar
